sample: All scenes among the same twelve with both annotated child and table class-aware matched to Grounding DINO boxes at IoU >=0.5. No outcome-dependent filtering; report missing-pair scenes separately.
input_change: Use matched detector child and parent boxes instead of annotated boxes for red/green image markings. Original RGB, prompt, SmolVLM2 revision, deterministic generation, strict parser and human RGB labels remain the same.
metrics: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN counts by RGB paired-relation label
Per-scene answer changes relative to oracle-box prompt
Detector pair coverage over all twelve scenes
limits: The set and oracle-box VLM responses have already been inspected. This is a post-hoc box-sensitivity diagnostic, not a held-out relation benchmark. Matching uses annotations only to select the pair for scoring.
